newsitem.title: USA: Xicor Q4 view below First Call.
newsitem.headline: Xicor Q4 view below First Call.

text.p: Xicor Inc said on Thursday that it estimates net income for the 13-week fourth quarter of 1996 to be between $3.2 million and $3.7 million, or between $.16 and $.18 a share, on sales of approximately $30.5 million.
According to First Call, the mean consensus estimates for Xicor's fourth quarter is $0.23 a share.
Xicor's net income for the 16-week fourth quarter of 1995 was $4.0 million, or $.21 per share, on sales of $36.4 million.
Fourth quarter 1995 results, prorated to a comparable 13-week basis, are net income of $3.3 million, or $.17 per share, on sales of $29.6 million.
Xicor said it estimates net income for 1996 to be between $13.5 million and $14.0 million, or between $.68 and $.70 per share, on sales of about $123.5 million.
This compares to net income of $10.0 million, or $.53 a share, on revenues of $113.6 million in 1995.

Xicor said it is evaluating, based on Statement of Financial Accounting Standards No. 109, the need to record a tax benefit in the fourth quarter of 1996 to reflect the release of a portion of valuation allowances previously recorded against Xicor's deferred tax assets.
If such a tax benefit is recorded, it would increase fourth quarter and 1996 net income from the company's current estimates.

The company said that sales for 1996 were constrained by insufficient product availability. It said this was due mostly due to equipment issues which particularly affected the fourth quarter of 1996 may continue to impact the first quarter of 1997.
